title: Background Work Witness policy scaffold
law: Phase 0 is doctrine and policy only. A named background lane is not a runtime lane.
z_work_definition: Z-WORK is a declared, policy-bounded unit of background-oriented work that remains visible and non-executing until a later charter explicitly opens a real runtime lane.
human_gate_rule: Any move from witness doctrine into executable background behavior requires an explicit later charter and human approval under hub governance.
notes: Phase 0 intentionally creates no reports, scripts, services, or runtime receipts.
The word pulse is conceptual in this phase and must not be interpreted as a timer or always-on loop.
Visibility and policy come before any execution discussion.
